# @vllnt/convex-reactions

> TypeScript Convex component for emoji reactions, up/down votes and likes on any resource: toggle a reaction, count per kind, page who reacted.

Install `@vllnt/convex-reactions` (builds from `main` use the `canary` dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`. Mount it with `app.use(reactions)` from `@vllnt/convex-reactions/convex.config` and call it through `new Reactions(components.reactions, { allowedKinds })` from host mutations and queries. A reaction is the edge `(authorRef, resourceRef, kind)` of opaque host strings. Mutations: `react` toggles the edge (add if absent, remove if present) and returns `{ reacted, action }`; it is not retry-idempotent. `unreact` removes it and returns `false` when there was nothing to remove. Queries: `counts` (`{ kind, count }[]` sorted by kind, read from one stored tally row per kind), `hasReacted`, `myReactions`, and `reactors` (oldest-first Convex pagination, `numItems` 1 through 1000, `maximumRowsRead` capped at 1000 except on reactive re-runs with an `endCursor`). One edge per subject per kind per resource is enforced inside the mutation transaction; `createdAt` comes from the server clock. Errors: `ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_REF` or `INVALID_KIND` (empty refs or kind in `react`/`unreact`) and `INVALID_PAGE_SIZE` (`reactors`); a kind outside `allowedKinds` throws a plain `Error` in the client, for `react`/`unreact` only. The host owns the subject, the resource, the vocabulary and auth; the component never reads host tables. Backend-only: no React entry.

## When to use

- Use it when users toggle a reaction (emoji, like, up/down vote) on a post, comment or any other record.
- Use it when you show per-kind counts and whether the current user reacted.
- Use it when you list who reacted with one kind, page by page.
- Do not use it when a reaction carries data (a comment, a star rating, a note): store it in your own table with `defineTable`.
- Do not use it when one resource gets a very high rate of reactions: each write updates one tally row per resource and kind; use `@convex-dev/sharded-counter`.
- Do not use it when you need to sort or rank resources by their reaction count: `counts` reads one resource at a time; use `@convex-dev/aggregate`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-reactions/` and match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing code. The `./` links below are files inside the installed package.

- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, common tasks, limits and gotchas
